metaDesc: Install SYLY, every attribute, events, the REST API, content sources, the Telegram bot, bring your own bot, accessibility and privacy.
lead: Everything you need to add the SYLY assistant to your site. Use the assistant on this page to ask about it: it reads this page.
instP: Three ways to load the same file. Put the script tag and the db-assistant tag before the closing body tag of your page.
inst1P: Use the address of the server that runs SYLY (yours or ours).
inst2P: jsDelivr serves the file from the public GitHub repository, pinned to a version tag. The api and content attributes must be full https:// addresses, because a CDN does not know where your server is.
inst3P: Install the package, then import it, or add a script tag that points into node_modules. The package has no dependencies.
inst3Note: The package is ready, but it is published only by the team lead with an npm account. Until then use the server or CDN version.
instGen: You can also build the tag with options and a live preview on the install page.
a_lang: Language of the assistant: am, en, ar, or any file module/i18n/CODE.json.
a_api: Base URL of the SYLY server, for example https://your-host/api. Empty: the assistant works alone with keyword search in the browser.
a_content: URL of a bilingual content file. Empty: the server's sections, then page reading.
a_site: Your site key from the dashboard (pk_…). The assistant loads your saved settings from the server. Attributes on the tag always win. Needs api.
a_theme: auto uses the host page's --bs-primary only if it passes 4.5:1 with white, otherwise a safe navy.
a_mode: panel: a button on the side edge opens a full-height panel. inline: the ask box sits in the page.
a_position: Which edge the panel button sits on.
a_primary: One colour as six hex digits, for example #1A5FB4. Ignored if it does not pass 4.5:1 with white.
a_selector: CSS selector of the lesson on your page, for page reading, for example #lesson.
a_readpage: Page reading: empty (only when there is no content file or server section), always (the page is added to the content file), off.
evP: All events bubble and are composed, so you can listen on document.
evMethods: Methods on the element: open(), close(), ask(text), openAccommodation({id, title}), showJobAlerts(keyword), getText(key, lang).
apiP: Every call is under /api/v1. The interactive documentation lets you try each one. Errors always come as {"detail": "words"}.
r_ask: Answer a question from the course, with sources.
r_content: The indexed sections. POST: your site sends its lessons to be indexed.
r_config: What the widget needs to know at start.
r_esc: Talk to a person: open a ticket, then send and poll messages.
r_voice: Text to speech and speech to text (these send text or audio online, so they need the learner's consent).
r_jobs: Test jobs with schema.org JobPosting, job alerts and interview-support requests.
r_sites: Developer portal: the public widget settings for a site key. The rest needs a sign-in.
contentP: The assistant uses the first source that has content.
c1: A content file (the content attribute): sections with id, url, title_en/am, text_en/am and keywords_en/am.
c2: Sections held by the server for this page (POST /api/v1/content).
c3: Page reading: the assistant reads the lesson on your page itself (headings h2 and h3), ignoring navigation, hidden parts, forms and ads. Nothing is stored. Use content-selector to point at the lesson.
botP: Every command works by tapping the menu, by typing a short phrase, or by sending a voice note. Longer messages are questions.
botLangP: The interface and phrases are drafts that need a native reader check. Speech recognition quality differs a lot by language.
l_am: Done. Typed Amharic works fully; spoken Amharic is weak until Addis AI has credit.
l_ar: Beta. Speech recognition works well on test clips.
byobP: Each college runs SYLY with its own bot. SYLY never receives your bot token.
byob1: Open @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot, then choose a name and a username that ends in bot.
byob2: Copy the token BotFather gives you.
byob3: Put it in your own server's .env file as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.
byob4: Start the bot with docker compose up -d bot.
byob5: Optional: send /setuserpic and /setdescription to BotFather to add your logo and a description.
byob6: The commands and phrases register themselves when the bot starts.
byobWarn: Never paste your bot token into a website or a chat. Keep it only in your server's .env.
byobUser: In the dashboard you can save the bot's public username (for example @MyCollegeHelpBot). It is not secret; it is used only to show the right link in your generated code.
a11yP: SYLY is built to WCAG 2.2 AA: real elements, visible focus, 44 px targets, 200% zoom, 320 px width, no time limits. Automated checks pass. Manual tests with TalkBack, NVDA and a co-designer are still pending, and the statement says so honestly.
a11yGoogle: The Google sign-in button is Google's own iframe. We add a text explanation and a skip link, but we cannot change its internals.
privP: Learners are never asked to sign in, questions are stored without names, and online AI is used only with the learner's consent.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
cmd_status: Your request and the latest reply
